_comment: Copy to agency.json and let the agency-setup skill fill it in. Everything here is what your AI is allowed to claim on your behalf. If it is not in this file, it does not go in a job post or an ad. Delete anything that is not true for your agency. NO PASSWORDS OR API KEYS IN THIS FILE — those go in .env.

one-on-one mentorship from the agency owner
leads: Describe honestly, or delete this line. e.g. 'agents purchase direct-mail and digital leads' or 'warm inbound leads supplied at no cost'.
